directives: No physical device shouldn’t be a blocker.
Review the locales now and prepare to submit.
Remove the ‘Unlock StudyPlanner’ notification pop up, make sure it is polished and runs perfect and fast, then finish submission with the new build and assets.

physicalCaptureRequirement.reason: The release owner explicitly directed that absence of a physical device must not block preparation.

truthConstraints: Simulator captures must remain labeled as simulator captures.
AI language review must not be described as native-human certification.
Build 86 screenshot-source hashes, dimensions, UI integrity, and locale bindings must still pass.

The release target is Build 87. Build 86-origin media may be reused because Build 87 changes only a post-entitlement alert and startup routing/sync timing; none of the approved screenshot states or visible UI pixels changed.
The Build 87 binary, bundle identifiers, entitlements, version/build metadata, signing, and IPA hash must pass before upload or submission.
